# Test Fixtures

This directory contains test files used for binwalk3 testing.

## Files
- `test.bin` - Basic test binary file
- `test_signatures.bin` - Binary with known signatures (ZIP, GZIP, etc.)
- `empty.bin` - Empty file for edge case testing
- `test.txt` - Text file for testing

These fixtures are used in the test suite to verify binwalk3 functionality.
